text: October 02, 2018 9:35am Comments Share: InvestorsObserver releases option trade reports for Apple, Facebook, Fortive, Gerdau and S&P 500 Financials Sector SPDR PR Newswire NEW YORK, Oct. 2, 2018 NEW YORK , Oct. 2, 2018 /PRNewswire/ -- InvestorsObserver issues critical PriceWatch Alerts for AAPL, FB, FTV, GGB, and XLF. Click a link below then choose between in-depth options trade idea report or a stock score report. XLF: https://www.investorsobserver.com/pr-user-choice-lp/?stocksymbol=XLF&prnumber=100220181 (Note: You may have to copy this link into your browser then press the [ENTER] key.) Options Report – Ideal trade ideas on up to seven different options trading strategies. The report shows all vital aspects of each option trade idea for each stock. Stock Report - Measures a stock's suitability for investment with a proprietary scoring system combining short and long-term technical factors with Wall Street's opinion including a 12-month price forecast. Everything you need to know about the market - quick & easy. Daily Analyst Rating A summary of each day’s top rating changes from sell-side analysts on the street. Fintech Focus Your weekly roundup of hot topics in the exciting world of fintech. Email for registering for Benzinga’s newsletters and alerts. • The Daily Analysts Ratings email will be received daily between 7am and 10am. • The Market in 5 Minutes email will be received daily between 7am and 8am. • The Fintech Focus email will be received every Friday between 2pm and 5pm.
